vulnTracker.clearDiscardsToken: Clearing the base URL turns the connection off for every organization and discards the stored token. You will have to enter the token again to reconnect.

general.defaultLanguageHint: New users in this tenant start with this language. Each user can override it in their profile.
general.defaultTimezoneHint: New users in this tenant see timestamps in this zone. Each user can override it in their profile. Stored times are always UTC.

general.allowVersionOverwriteWarning: Enabling this lets a publish replace an existing version's bytes. The change is audited (package.replace records both hashes) but the supply-chain implications are real — packages your developers already pulled may have different contents on a refetch. Toggling this setting is itself audited.
general.versionOverwritePolicyHint: Controls whether publishing a duplicate (name, version) is allowed. Block rejects all overwrites. Exception allows per-package overrides via the Packages page. Allow permits overwrites org-wide.
general.versionOverwritePolicyWarning: Allowing overwrites lets a publish replace an existing version's bytes. The change is audited (package.replace records both hashes) but the supply-chain implications are real — packages your developers already pulled may have different contents on a refetch. Toggling this setting is itself audited.
general.airGappedHint: When on, Dependably makes no outbound network requests for this organization: upstream proxy fetches are disabled (uncached packages return 404), and vulnerability and deprecation-metadata scans skip this organization. Use for isolated / air-gapped deployments.
general.airGappedEnforcedNote: Enforced instance-wide by the operator (AIR_GAPPED); can't be changed here.
general.airGappedWarning: Outbound requests are disabled for this organization: uncached upstream packages return 404, and vulnerability and deprecation scans skip it.
general.requireMfaHint: When on, all users in this organization must complete MFA enrolment before accessing any API endpoints. The instance REQUIRE_MFA env var enforces this across every organization.
general.requireMfaEnforcedNote: Enforced instance-wide by the operator (REQUIRE_MFA); can't be changed here.

uploadLimits.exceedsCeiling: Cannot exceed the instance ceiling of {mb} MB.
uploadLimits.globalBlankHint: Blank uses the instance limit of {mb} MB.
uploadLimits.globalBlankNoLimitHint: Blank allows uploads of any size — no instance limit is configured.
uploadLimits.perEcoHint: Overrides the limit above for this ecosystem only. Blank uses the limit above, or the instance limit if that's blank too.

retention.keepProjectVersionsHint: Caps the SBOM/VEX/SARIF versions kept per project and releases the documents of the ones it removes. The latest version of a project is never removed, whatever its age.
retention.activityDaysHint: Unlike the limits above, empty is not unlimited here: activity rows carry per-download IP data, so they are bounded by the ACTIVITY_RETENTION_DAYS instance default.

proxy.passthroughHint: When disabled, only packages already cached in this registry are served.
proxy.passthroughOverriddenByAirGap: Overridden by the Air-gapped environment setting (General tab): proxy passthrough is off while air-gapped.
proxy.osvToleranceHint: Packages with a vulnerability score above this threshold are blocked (0 – 10). Default 10 allows all.
proxy.minReleaseAgeHint: Block proxy fetches of upstream versions younger than this. Default 0 allows all. The age is measured against the upstream registry's published timestamp; versions with no upstream timestamp are allowed through.
proxy.reservedHint: Dependency-confusion guard: names matching these per-ecosystem patterns are never fetched or merged from upstream — only your hosted content serves. Names you have published are protected automatically; reserve patterns here to also cover names you haven't published yet.
proxy.installScriptAllowlistHint: Packages exempt from the install-script block gate. When the policy above is 'Block', versions listed here are served normally regardless of whether they ship an install/lifecycle script. Use this to permit known-good build tools (e.g. esbuild, node-gyp) while keeping the gate active for everything else.
proxy.blockDeprecatedHint: How upstream-deprecated versions are handled. Warn surfaces a 'deprecated' status in the UI and API. Block new refuses a deprecated version on cache miss — it is never fetched, cached, or served — while already-cached versions keep serving. Block all additionally returns 403 for already-cached versions once deprecated. Deprecation data is captured at proxy fetch and refreshed daily by the deprecation-refresh job.
proxy.blockDeprecatedBlockNew: Block new — refuse new deprecated fetches
proxy.blockDeprecatedBlockAll: Block all — also stop serving cached
proxy.blockRevokedHint: How versions removed from the upstream registry (npm unpublish, PyPI delete, a takedown of a compromised release) are handled. Detected daily by the deprecation-refresh job when a cached version no longer appears in upstream metadata; a reappearance clears it. Warn surfaces a 'revoked' badge in the UI and API while cached copies keep serving. Block returns 403 on fetch and serve and quarantines the version for review. Revoked differs from deprecated — the version is gone upstream entirely and can never be re-fetched. npm and PyPI only.
proxy.blockMaliciousHint: How versions carrying a malicious-package advisory (OSV MAL- reports from the OpenSSF malicious-packages feed, gathered by the regular vulnerability scan) are handled. These advisories usually carry no CVSS score, so the OSV score tolerance never applies to them. Block returns 403 on fetch and serve; Warn surfaces the advisory in the vulnerability report only. A per-version manual allow override still wins, as the escape hatch for false-positive reports.
proxy.blockKevHint: How versions are handled when one of their advisories aliases a CVE in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog — confirmed exploited in the wild, independent of CVSS score. The catalogue is refreshed daily by the threat-feed job. Block returns 403 on fetch and serve; Warn surfaces the KEV flag in the vulnerability report only. A per-version manual allow override still wins.
proxy.blockInstallScriptsHint: How versions that ship an install/lifecycle script are handled. Such a script runs automatically on install — an npm preinstall/install/postinstall hook, a PyPI sdist setup.py, or a NuGet tools install.ps1/init.ps1 or build .targets/.props. Block returns 403 on fetch and serve; Warn surfaces the badge in the version detail only. A per-version manual allow override still wins.
proxy.verifyNpmSignaturesHint: Verify the npm registry's signature on each proxied version against pinned trust anchors, the same check npm audit signatures performs. Block fails closed — a version that fails verification or carries no signature is refused (never cached or served); Warn records the outcome without blocking. Applies to proxy-fetched versions only. Configure keys in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors.
proxy.verifyNpmSignaturesNoKeys: No npm trust anchors are configured. Add the registry's SPKI public keys in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors to enable signature verification.
proxy.verifyNuGetSignaturesHint: Verify the signature embedded in each proxied .nupkg against pinned trust anchors. Block fails closed — a version whose signature fails verification or that carries no signature is refused (never cached or served); Warn records the outcome without blocking. Applies to proxy-fetched versions only. Configure certificates in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors.
proxy.verifyNuGetSignaturesNoCerts: No NuGet trust anchors are configured. Add the registry's signing certificates in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors to enable signature verification.
proxy.verifyPyPiAttestationsHint: Verify the PEP 740 digital attestation for each proxied PyPI file against pinned Sigstore roots and a Trusted Publisher allowlist. The attestation's signed digest is bound to the downloaded bytes, the Fulcio leaf is chained to a pinned root, and the publisher identity is matched. Block fails closed — a version whose attestation fails verification or that carries none is refused (never cached or served); Warn records the outcome without blocking. Applies to proxy-fetched versions only. Configure roots and publishers in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors.
proxy.verifyPyPiAttestationsNoRoots: No PyPI Sigstore roots and Trusted Publishers are configured. Add them in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors to enable attestation verification.
proxy.verifyRpmSignaturesHint: Verify the OpenPGP signature embedded in each proxied RPM package header against the org's trusted GPG keys. Block fails closed — a package whose signature fails verification or that carries none is refused (never cached or served); Warn records the outcome without blocking. Applies to proxy-fetched packages only. Requires at least one RPM trust anchor to enable.
proxy.verifyRpmSignaturesNoKey: No RPM trust anchors are configured. Add the repository's signing key in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors to enable signature verification.
proxy.verifyMavenSignaturesHint: Verify the detached OpenPGP signature (.asc sidecar) for each proxied Maven artefact against pinned trust anchors. Block fails closed — a version whose .asc fails verification or that carries none is refused (never cached or served); Warn records the outcome without blocking. Applies to proxy-fetched versions only. Configure keys in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors.
proxy.verifyMavenSignaturesNoKeys: No Maven trust anchors are configured. Add the repository's signing keys in Settings → Signatures → Trust anchors to enable signature verification.
proxy.maxEpssToleranceHint: Maximum FIRST.org EPSS exploitation probability (0.0–1.0) tolerated across a version's advisories. EPSS estimates the likelihood a CVE is exploited within 30 days; for example 0.5 blocks versions with an advisory considered more likely than not to be exploited. Scores are refreshed daily by the threat-feed job. Leave empty to disable.

upstreamRegistries.hint: Per ecosystem, the registries this proxy fetches from, in priority order. The top entry is tried first; on a miss or unreachable upstream the next is tried. Drag a row by its handle to reorder. With no registries configured, proxying is disabled for that ecosystem — only already-cached packages are served.
upstreamRegistries.emptyDisabled: No upstream registries — proxying is disabled for {ecosystem}.

symbolServer.label: Symbol server
symbolServer.hint: SSQP base URL this upstream serves PDBs from. A symbol server is a different host from the v3 index, so it cannot be derived from it — nuget.org's is https://symbols.nuget.org/download/symbols, and a nuget.org upstream is set to it automatically. Leave empty to turn symbol proxying off for this upstream.

modal.title: Add upstream registry
modal.urlHint: Base URL of the upstream registry (e.g. https://pypi.org, https://registry.npmjs.org).
modal.name: Label (optional)

auth.secretHint: Write-only — not returned by the API after saving.

oci.hostHint: Registry hostname without protocol (e.g. registry-1.docker.io, mcr.microsoft.com).
oci.prefixesHint: One prefix per line (or comma-separated). First-match-wins against the requested repository path. Use a blank line to add the catch-all prefix that matches everything.
oci.secretHint: Write-only — not returned by the API after saving.
oci.tokenEndpointHint: Override the default Docker Hub token endpoint. Leave blank to use https://auth.docker.io/token.
oci.catchAllWarn: Registries listed below this catch-all are never reached.

rpmMode.label: Hosted publishing
rpmMode.hint: Passthrough forwards upstream repodata verbatim and refuses hosted RPM uploads while an upstream is configured (a local package would shadow upstream and break dnf resolution). Merged serves a combined local and upstream index and allows hosted uploads. Inherit follows the instance default and changes automatically if the operator changes it.

terraform.protocolHint: Provider registry resolves versions and hands out download URLs on another host. Network mirror serves both from this one upstream — pick it for a Dependably or other network-mirror upstream.

proxy.blockKevRansomwareHint: Narrower than the exploited-CVE gate above: applies only to CVEs CISA marks as used in ransomware campaigns. Leave the gate above at Off and set this to Block to refuse only the ransomware-linked ones rather than the whole catalogue. Acts only on an explicit CISA verdict — CVEs it has not assessed are covered by the broader gate, not this one.
proxy.blockSsvcExploitationHint: Acts on CISA's Vulnrichment exploitation assessment, which grades far more CVEs than the exploited-CVE catalogue above and so catches exploitation CISA has evidence for but has not catalogued. Requires the vulnerability tracker connection; without one, no advisory carries an assessment and this gate never fires however it is set.
proxy.maxEpssPercentileHint: Blocks when an advisory ranks above this percentile (0.00–1.00). A rank keeps its meaning when FIRST recalibrates the model, where the probability ceiling above tracks absolute risk. Set either or both — whichever trips first blocks. Empty to disable.
